content: Safe non-trimming MSBuild exe-size levers beyond EnableCompressionInSingleFile/SatelliteResourceLanguages/InvariantGlobalization: DebugType=none (only helps if DebugType=embedded was previously set; default is portable/separate .pdb, so no effect on bundled exe size for this project), UseSystemResourceKeys=true (strips exception message strings, replaces with resource keys). PublishReadyToRun INCREASES exe size (AOT native code added) and PublishAot/PublishTrimmed both trigger the same COM/P-Invoke static-analysis stripping risk already ruled out for this project.
